title: Goodness of God
definition: The goodness of God means that God is perfectly good in His nature, works, purposes, and gifts.
summary: God is good, and all true goodness flows from Him.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the goodness of God by giving Himself for sinners and showing compassion to the needy.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's goodness means He is morally perfect, generous, kind, wise, and faithful. He is the source and measure of all true goodness.

God's goodness is seen in creation, providence, patience, mercy, and salvation. Even when His ways are hard to understand, His character remains good.

The cross is the deepest display of God's goodness toward sinners. In Christ, God gives not merely gifts, but Himself.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Suffering can make people question whether God is good. This doctrine matters because it anchors faith in God's character rather than changing circumstances.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Taste and see that the Lord is good. Remember His gifts, trust His heart in trials, and reflect His goodness through generosity and mercy.
